partyMembers.description: Presence channel (Echo name party.{code}.members). Joinable only by non-banned Members of the Party; unknown codes, non-Members, banned Members and unauthenticated callers are refused identically. Member payload carries only nickname and avatar. Also carries Live Stats updates (display names only, no member ids).

partyMember.description: Private per-Member channel (Echo name party.{code}.member.{memberId}). Authorisable only by that Member's own user while not banned; carries Request rejection notices Request decision notices (pending, approved, rejected, removed), and the Member's own Vote and Rating changes, and the Ban notice sent just before the connection is terminated.

partyModerators.description: Private Moderator channel (Echo name party.{code}.moderators). Authorisable only by non-banned Host and Moderators, re-evaluated on every subscription; unknown codes, Guests, VIPs, banned Members and unauthenticated callers are refused. Carries Pending Requests and Party Log entries.

player.description: Private Player channel (Echo name player.{code}). Authorisable only by an unrevoked Player Token for that Party (ability player:connect); User sessions are refused. Carries Soloist-native command frames to the Player and accepts inbound Pusher client events (client-*) from it.

partyBrowserPlayer.description: Host-only private channel (Echo name party.{code}.browser-player). Authorisable only by the Party's Host. Hands the next track to the Host's Browser Player just-in-time.
